title: Tim Cook speaks out on the Cambridge Analytica scandal, says Facebook's collection of user data 'shouldn't exist' (AAPL)
text: Tim Cook speaks out on the Cambridge Analytica scandal, says Facebook's collection of user data 'shouldn't exist' (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Mar 25, 2018, 1:05 pm 20 pts In response to a question about the Cambridge Analytica scandal, Apple CEO Tim Cook said the situation was "dire." He said the ability of people to access personal data shows what websites that people browse or shows who their contacts are should "not exist." Apple's business model is unlike…
